text: Under German law the decisive factor in classifying a token is which rights are associated with it; labels such as participation token, utility token, or payment token give only initial guidance and cannot be relied upon outside a comprehensive and binding regulatory classification.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Initial Coin Offerings The Top 25 Jurisdictions and Their Comparative Regulatory Responses (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3117224

isBasedOn.name: Initial Coin Offerings The Top 25 Jurisdictions and Their Comparative Regulatory Responses

abstract: A prior classification of the token (i.e. as a "participation token", "utility token", or "payment token") can provide initial guidance as to the type of token it is under German law, but is not to be relied upon outside a comprehensive and binding regulatory classification.
